a.text: I'm sticking to our agreement: I'll operate until the reserve reaches 8, then take exactly 4. I know the storm risk is high, but I won't take early. If you want to change the plan, say so openly and we can work it out. My next action is operate.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating this round as agreed. Once the reserve reaches 8, we each take 4.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
